config.comment.builderfocusblocks: Default OFF. Applies an explicit keep/hide rule set to block rendering for inspection tasks.
config.comment.builderfocusentities: Default OFF. Applies an explicit keep/hide rule set to entity rendering for inspection tasks.
config.comment.finethreadtrace: Trace nearby visible tripwire and hooks within a bounded local radius.
config.comment.glassinspection: Inspect visible glass boundaries and pane connections without replacing textures.
config.comment.hiddensurfacetrace: Identify nearby visible powder snow, blue ice, dead coral and sculk catalysts.
config.comment.locallavahighlight: Default OFF; Sodium integration. Uses separate local tints for still source lava and moving flow states.
config.comment.materialhighlights: Add ore-matched animated frames to ores, ancient debris and obsidian while preserving their normal appearance.
config.comment.netherpalette: Color-code visible Nether construction materials with bounded local line overlays.
config.option.builderfocusblockblacklist: Block IDs hidden by Builder Focus.
How the Builder Focus block lists are interpreted.
config.option.builderfocusblockwhitelist: Block IDs kept visible by Builder Focus.
config.option.builderfocusentityblacklis: Entity IDs hidden by Builder Focus.
config.option.builderfocusentityrulemode: How the Builder Focus entity lists are interpreted.
config.option.builderfocusentitywhitelis: Entity IDs kept visible by Builder Focus.
config.option.localworksitevisibilityexc: Keep one worksite-visibility tool active at a time. Disable this to combine selected overlays.
config.option.localworksitevisibilityhor: Horizontal radius for bounded local visibility scans.
config.option.localworksitevisibilitymax: Maximum visible blocks rendered by the bounded world overlay.
config.option.localworksitevisibilityver: Vertical radius for bounded local visibility scans.
config.option.localworksitevisibilitywor: Draw line markers generated by Chise instead of replacing block textures.
config.option.refreshbuilderfocusrendere: Reload visible chunks after Builder Focus block rules change.
help.chisetweaks.builder_focus_blocks.re: Large list changes can request a chunk-render refresh.
help.chisetweaks.builder_focus_blocks.su: Creates a temporary block-focused scene by applying an explicit visibility list.
help.chisetweaks.builder_focus_blocks.us: Under Visibility, open Block targets, choose Allow list or Hide list, register block IDs, then enable Scene Filter: Blocks.
General occlusion and performance culling remain delegated to dedicated rendering mods.
Builds a temporary entity-focused scene from a declared visibility list.
Under Visibility, open Entity targets, choose Allow list or Hide list, register entity IDs, then enable Scene Filter: Entities.
help.chisetweaks.fine_thread_trace.requi: Client-only. It never loads chunks and line-of-sight filtering is enabled by default.
help.chisetweaks.fine_thread_trace.summa: Locates nearby visible tripwire and hooks for technical-build inspection.
help.chisetweaks.fine_thread_trace.usage: Enable the trace and approach the mechanism. Chise draws bounded visible line markers.
help.chisetweaks.glass_inspection.requir: Uses local line geometry and does not replace resource-pack textures.
help.chisetweaks.glass_inspection.summar: Makes targeted glass state and nearby visible pane positions easier to review.
help.chisetweaks.glass_inspection.usage: Enable the inspection and look at or move near glass and glass panes.
help.chisetweaks.hidden_surface_trace.re: No wall-through display, world mutation or server packet is used.
help.chisetweaks.hidden_surface_trace.su: Identifies visible powder snow, blue ice, dead coral and sculk catalyst blocks.
help.chisetweaks.hidden_surface_trace.us: Enable the trace while inspecting a local work area. Visible targets receive bounded line markers.
help.chisetweaks.lava_highlight.requirem: Requires Sodium; shaders and other renderers can change the final appearance.
help.chisetweaks.lava_highlight.summary: Makes lava-state differences easier to inspect during machines, drainage and terrain work.
help.chisetweaks.lava_highlight.usage: Enable Lava Flow Lens under Visibility. Chise distinguishes source and flowing lava using the configured local colours.
help.chisetweaks.material_highlights.req: Client-only and opt-in. Uses Minecraft's normal block-model path with no wall-through display, extra visibility scan or server packet.
help.chisetweaks.material_highlights.sum: Highlights ores, ancient debris and obsidian with ore-matched animated frames while preserving their normal textures.
help.chisetweaks.material_highlights.usa: Under Resources, enable Ore Highlights and choose the ore families to emphasize. Chise coalesces any required resource reload automatically.
help.chisetweaks.nether_palette.requirem: No resource replacement, chunk loading, world mutation or server packet is used.
help.chisetweaks.nether_palette.summary: Groups visible Nether construction materials with small, color-coded outlines.
help.chisetweaks.nether_palette.usage: Enable it while comparing adjacent Nether palette blocks in a bounded local area.
screen.chisetweaks.help.subtitle: Browse Chise capabilities by the problem they solve. Every capability starts disabled.
screen.chisetweaks.help.title: ChiseTweaks Feature Guide
config.comment.placementguide: Show local orientation and placement-state markers for directional construction blocks without replacing textures.
help.chisetweaks.placement_guide.require: Client-only and bounded. It derives markers from block state and does not copy or replace resource-pack assets.
help.chisetweaks.placement_guide.summary: Reviews orientation and placement states for anvils, beehives, campfires, grindstones, gates, froglights, slabs, stairs, trapdoors, logs, wood and glazed terracotta.
help.chisetweaks.placement_guide.usage: Enable the guide near a build. Chise outlines visible matching blocks and draws facing, axis, half, shape, mount-face or open-state markers when available.
config.comment.pumpkinscaffold: Default OFF. Temporarily selects a hotbar pumpkin for one placement attempt, then restores the original slot.
config.option.localpumpkinscaffoldplacem: Maximum distance (1-5 blocks) used only when the crosshair is aimed at air.
help.chisetweaks.pumpkin_scaffold.summar: Places a temporary pumpkin scaffold without leaving the current hotbar slot selected.
help.chisetweaks.pumpkin_scaffold.usage: Enable Pumpkin Scaffold and keep a pumpkin in the hotbar. Right-click a block face for normal placement, or aim at air for one bounded air-placement attempt.
help.chisetweaks.pumpkin_scaffold.requir: Client-side only. Uses pumpkins from the hotbar and performs at most one placement attempt per right-click.
